record.title: DICTO 1:2 Truncated Octahedron: The 4D Vacuus of the Permutohedron
record.abstract: The 4D permutohedron is the skeleton of the web of all orderings of 1 to 5 (120 orders, 240 exchanges of neighbouring values). Its 4D Vacuus is the set of 3D slices through its centre that between them carry all of its 2-faces, as DICTO's 3D Vacuus solids are built from central planes carrying all their edges. Theorem 1: the 150 two-dimensional faces lie in exactly 65 central slices, in four congruence classes (30, 20, 10, 5), each described exactly. Theorem 2: the five slices that hold the middle value fixed are the DICTO 1:2 Truncated Octahedron (the permutohedron of 1, 2, 4, 5: squares of side 1, hexagons with sides 1 and 2 in turn), and any two cross in a regular hexagon through the centre. Theorem 2b: for 2m+1 values, where k of the central slices p_i = m+1 cross, the section is the permutohedron of explicit values (k odd: the middle k values taken out; k even: the middle k+1 taken out and the middle value put back), down to a regular hexagon in every odd dimension; Lemma 2a gives the section of any permutohedron by one coordinate held fixed. Theorem 3: the number of central hyperplanes through the ridges of the permutohedron of 1..n is 3, 15, 65, 225, 770, 2443, 7761 for dimensions 2 to 8, with a closed formula. Theorem 4: the semi-uniform truncated octahedra T(x) of DICTONIC's golden bond are the permutohedra of four values placed symmetrically about zero. A search found no earlier construction of a 4D solid from central slices carrying all its 2-faces.
